import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt


def task_func(data):
    if isinstance(data, pd.DataFrame):
        df = data.copy()
        if df.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input data must be a 2D array.")
    else:
        arr = np.asarray(data)
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input data must be a 2D array.")
        df = pd.DataFrame(arr)

    try:
        numeric_df = df.apply(lambda col: pd.to_numeric(col, errors="raise"))
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError("Input data must contain only numeric values.") from exc

    result_df = numeric_df.copy()
    result_df["Average"] = numeric_df.mean(axis=1)

    corr_matrix = result_df.corr(numeric_only=True)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
    sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, ax=ax, annot=True, cmap="coolwarm", vmin=-1, vmax=1)
    ax.set_title("Correlation Matrix Heatmap")

    return result_df, ax
